ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَهَبْ لَنَا سِرًّا بِالْأَسْرَارِ مَسْرُوْرًا .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa hab lanā sirran bi ‘l-asrāri masrūrā.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and bestow upon us a secret from the secrets of happiness!

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الصَّادِقِ الْأَمِيْنِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Aṣ-Ṣādiqi ‘l-Amīn.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the truthful and trustworthy!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الَّذِيْ جَاءَ بِالْحَقِّ الْمُبِيْنِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī jā’a bi ‘l-Haqqi ‘l-Mubīn.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the one who came with manifest truth!
